name: Franchise Architect: Football
currentFocus: Session 94 ran a full-spectrum /audit against the LIVE ORIGIN rather than the source tree, and that choice is why four of fourteen ranked findings exist: what ships here is source -> build-pages rewrite -> edge policy, and two of those three stages leave no trace in git. The headline defect is that the site's own Content-Security-Policy was refusing a script the site itself serves. Cloudflare injects its Web Analytics beacon into every delivered document; script-src admitted 'self' plus four hashes and nothing else. Production had therefore collected ZERO pageviews and thrown a CSP violation on every page load, while every launch-readiness judgement about the public surface was made without a single production datapoint. No automated check had seen it because -- measured on this origin across two routes -- the edge injects the beacon only for browser-shaped requests, and verify-edge-policy-application.mjs fetched with Accept: application/json, so it was auditing a document no visitor ever receives. It now fetches as a browser does and asserts the served policy admits every external origin the served document requests; both admitted hosts were read out of beacon.min.js itself. Negative control returns both violations by name against today's live policy and none against the new one. Three further findings: check-public-truth had no freshness dimension, so status.html sat 24 sessions stale while green; the front door led with a live widget rendering '0 contributors'; and the Settings tab was the structural reason two god-mode surfaces survived thirty sessions, so the owner economy now has its own Boardroom and seven developer diagnostics require ?dev=1. New /simulation.html publishes the measured-realism anchor rendered from progressionParity's own constants. Three ranked premises were CORRECTED during implementation rather than implemented as written (one would have reversed DECISIONS 2026-08-04), and one item was skipped with its premise corrected. A /code-review high then found ten real defects in this session's own work, all fixed and pinned by regression tests. Canonical receipt 1,266/1,266 direct exit 0, up from 1,220. Public launch remains HOLD and launchReady stays false.
nextMilestone: The strongest known item is unchanged and now twice-carried: gate the long-horizon facility equilibrium. The S93 upkeep design rests on a measured season-15 dispersion turnaround that no test asserts -- argued rather than gated, the exact shape this project keeps re-finding. Second: verify the analytics beacon actually REPORTS once the S94 CSP reaches production; admitted is not reporting, and a still-silent dashboard after deploy is a live finding rather than a deploy delay. Third and fourth, both carried from S93 and both now more load-bearing than when booked: owner.cash scale has never been calibrated for a league where cash actually moves, and FACILITY_MARKET_PROFILE's appetite weights are judgement rather than measurement -- the newest un-sourced constants in the codebase. Process note booked to the board: run /code-review BEFORE the canonical receipt, not after; running it late this session invalidated a 45-minute six-shard run that had to be repeated in full.

lastVerification: S94 canonical Node receipt 1,266/1,266 across all six shards, direct exit 0 (not a wrapper status), up from S93's 1,220 with 46 new tests -- 12 of them regressions pinning defects a code review found in this session's own work. 18/18 Playwright specs across the three affected suites. Build, smoke-pages, browser-reachability (83 modules), boot-budget (641,330/730,000 with 0 lazy leaks and per-island headroom at or above the 15% floor), promise-observability (0 silent sinks), windows-hide, shard-coverage and public-truth all green. Measured, not asserted: the delivered-document audit returns two violations by name against today's live production policy and browser-shaped document, and none against the new policy on the same document; the release-note freshness gate reported 24 sessions unpublished before its fix; repository weight fell 107 MB -> 35.9 MB in docs and 861 KB -> 439 KB in context ledgers, each verified line by line before the change was kept. Two tests-ui/app.spec.js failures are PRE-EXISTING, confirmed by reproducing them on the stashed pre-S94 tree, and are not claimed as green.
freeTierAuditNote: Session 75 refresh: browser-first game plus a bounded, cached community aggregate on the existing shared self-hosted server. No language model, email, paid analytics vendor, or per-user API spend; marginal cost remains zero within current fixed infrastructure capacity.

testShardReceipt.note: S94 canonical receipt, direct exit 0: 1,266/1,266 across all six shards (core 194, runtime 740, sim-contract 79, sim-realism 1, long 5, studio 247), up from S93's 1,220. This is the SECOND run of the session and the receipt of record. Run 1 was discarded because it surfaced three genuine defects in this session's own work rather than because of flakiness: a raw node:child_process import that CANON-016's windows-hide guard refuses, four new test suites unassigned to any shard (so npm test and CI would have skipped them silently while every local run passed), and an edge-policy fixture that correctly turned HOLD once document-agreement joined the attestation conjunction. All three were root-fixed -- the fixture was corrected rather than the conjunction relaxed -- and the run repeated in full. Behavioural source was frozen before this run. Runtime, sim-contract, sim-realism and long are unchanged from S93, which is the correct signal for a session that moved public surfaces, build gates and information architecture without touching simulation behaviour.
